sources.quote: the exact Cesàro mean of the capped ramp `min(k, C)` over `h` hits is `C − C(C−1)/(2h)` for `h ≥ C` — i.e. the engine's own foundation document models Carve as a single capped stack COUNT k ≤ C, not as an unbounded set of independent per-application debuffs.

step_0_mechanic_read_from_cached_wiki_te.statement: Carve is ONE unique (passives[0].unique == true) per-target debuff instance carrying a stack COUNTER. Stacks cap at 5. Total armor reduction is ADDITIVE in stacks: 6% per stack, 30% at 5 stacks (the wiki states both the per-stack figure and the 5-stack total, and 5 x 6% = 30% exactly, so the composition is additive, not multiplicative).
step_0_mechanic_read_from_cached_wiki_te.falsifier_check_multiplicative: If the 5 stacks composed multiplicatively the total would be 1 - 0.94^5 = 0.26610 = 26.61%, which contradicts the cached text's stated 'up to 30% at 5 stacks'. Multiplicative per-stack composition is therefore excluded by the source.
step_0_mechanic_read_from_cached_wiki_te.holder: participant `main` (Jax) holds exactly ONE Black Cleaver; participant `ally:Lulu` holds none. One holder + one item + one subject = ONE Carve debuff instance on `enemy:Aatrox`, shared by the whole allied side (target_scope 'one_teammate' is the SUBJECT scope, not a licence to instantiate one debuff per application).

step_1_arming_history_to_live_stack_coun.note: Each arming records expires_at = time + 6.0; no arming's window has lapsed at any of the three priced timestamps (earliest expiry 6.00 > 3.47). The number of un-expired armings is therefore 3 / 6 / 8 at t = 1.16 / 2.31 / 3.47 - and the last two EXCEED the 5-stack cap, which is itself proof that 'one row per live arming' is not the mechanic.
step_1_arming_history_to_live_stack_coun.cross_check: The engine's own arming events already carry the capped truth: stack_count never exceeds 5.0 and amount never exceeds 0.30 anywhere in the pre-change series. The cap was respected in the arming ledger and then discarded at publication.

step_2_live_shred_and_the_single_correct.publication_rule: reduce_resistance applies the percentage reduction ONCE to the running armor value (math-foundations 2.2). One debuff instance => one r_pct => exactly ONE support_resistance_reduction row, at index [0], carrying the LIVE CUMULATIVE fraction and its factor. Every index >= 1 must be absent.

step_3_the_pre_change_rows_are_the_same_.observation: Every pre-change row's `fraction` is a CUMULATIVE total reached at some arming (0.06, 0.12, 0.18, 0.24, 0.30, 0.30, ...), not an increment, and every row's `factor` is that cumulative fraction's full amplification against A = 120. Publishing all of them side by side and composing them multiplicatively charges the cumulative shred once per arming - it double-counts the SAME 6% first stack 3 / 6 / 8 times over.
step_3_the_pre_change_rows_are_the_same_.overstatement: at t=3.47 the pre-change list overstates the shred amplifier by 2.884600 / 1.195652 = 2.4126x.

There is no pre-mitigation reading available: damage == pair_damage == raw_damage in all three records, so the same composed product is what all three fields carry.

prior_brief_defect_superseded.supersedes: R-18 single-leaf briefs on this cluster (10 x carve_rearm_dedupe + 1 x events_46_damage_triple), re-adjudicated under the R-15/R-18 repeated-source amendment as ONE well-posed whole-series question.
prior_brief_defect_superseded.defect: The prior brief handed each investigator one row path plus two values out of a single-source list of 3/6/8 rows. That triple does not determine a question: the investigator could not see (a) that all rows in the list name the same source 'Black Cleaver - Carve', (b) that their `fraction` values are successive CUMULATIVE totals (0.06, 0.12, 0.18, 0.24, 0.30, 0.30, ...) of one unique per-target debuff rather than independent increments, (c) the support_events arming timeline that fixes which arming each row prices and shows the row count exceeding the 5-stack cap, or (d) sibling row [0]. Ten of thirteen prior investigators wrote the missing fact down as their own stated falsifier - 'if support_resistance_reduction[0] is ALSO a Black Cleaver - Carve row, then the removal is a de-duplication and the verdict flips' - and had no way to check it. Each therefore priced a single live 6%-per-stack shred correctly and answered a question nobody asked. The same defect on events[46]/raw_damage: handed one field of a three-field damage record without its siblings, the prior adjudication rested on a pre-mitigation reading of `raw_damage` that the pre-change record itself refutes (raw_damage == damage == pair_damage == 128.9), and without the arming series could not see that 128.9 is the composed product of the eight duplicate rows.
prior_brief_defect_superseded.what_this_receipt_adds: The whole arming series, the cached wiki text establishing the additive 6%/stack, 5-stack, 30%-max single-instance mechanic, the sibling rows, the 5-stack cap violated by the row COUNT itself, and the arithmetic showing the pre-change damage triple is the product of the duplicates. The falsifier the prior investigators named is hereby checked and it fires: row [0] IS a 'Black Cleaver - Carve' row, every row in every list is, and the removal is a de-duplication.

verdict_rationale: One holder, one Black Cleaver, one unique per-target Carve debuff with a capped stack counter => exactly one armor_reduction_percent row (index [0]) may be published. Index [4] is a duplicate and its absence post-change is correct. The pre-change value at this path was not a mis-valued row - it was a row that should never have existed.
